item.description:
Dan Signor is a seasoned musician with a career spanning over two decades. Dan‘s musical journey has taken him overseas, where he has shared the stage and his soul-infused melodies with fans around the world. Known as the modern-day piano man, Dan Signor’s solo performances are a unique blend of rock, incorporating not only his masterful piano skills but also his soulful, raspy vocals, acoustic guitar, and his signature percussive kick drum. Influenced by legends like Ray Charles and contemporary rock icons like Kings of Leon, Dan‘s music resonates with a raw and raspy voice that adds depth and emotion to his performances. Dan‘s repertoire includes a mix of original compositions and crowd-pleasing cover tunes, ensuring that every audience member is engaged and entertained. Hendo Fun Friends Music on Main is Hendersonville's beloved Summer Concert Series, bringing live music, community, and summertime fun to downtown Hendersonville. Gather with friends and neighbors for unforgettable evenings filled with a community coming together through music. Concerts take place throughout the Summer from 7-9 pm with audience seating opening after 5:30 pm. Don't forget your chairs! Concessions will be available for purchase, making Music on Main the perfect way to spend a summer evening in Hendersonville.
Music on Main remains free to attend thanks in large part to the generosity of our community. Donations from the audience members help support performer fees, event operations, and the continuation of this long-standing tradition. If you enjoy the concerts and are able, please consider making a donation the help keep the music playing for years to come.
Source: Hendo Fun Friends

item.title: Shut Up & Write!® in Hendersonville — Wed Aug 19, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
When you show up, say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once you’re all settled, take some time to chat with your fellow writers. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
**A note about the format** We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.

item.title: Weekly Critique — Wed Aug 19, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Writers This is the standing weekly critique. Bring anything new you're working on to share with the group. If you don't have a project to share, you are most welcome to attend, discuss, and get inspired.
For our group discussion, please bring at least 8-10 printed copies of your piece. That way, we can all read through each other's work and provide feedback.
Sharing our creative efforts is an important part of the writing process. I'm really looking forward to reading what you've been working on. Don't worry if it's still a rough draft.
If you're having trouble finding us, look for a placard on the table with the group's name.
If you would like to join our group email list for updates regarding contests, events, and more [you can sign up on our website](https://avlwriters.com/).
Source: AVL Writers

Center for Spiritual Living Asheville **🌎 Wed Nite Special: Building a New Earth** *With Forrest Rivers*
📅 Wednesday, August 19 🕡 6:30 PM 💝 Love Offering
In a world that often feels filled with uncertainty—from conflict and economic challenges to healthcare concerns and environmental change—it can be easy to wonder how one person can make a difference.
**✨ The answer begins within.** Join inspirational speaker, author, and spiritual coach Forrest Rivers for an uplifting and interactive evening exploring how each of us can help create a more peaceful, compassionate, and harmonious New Earth.
*Together we'll discover practical and spiritual ways to:* 🌱 Cultivate inner peace in challenging times 💖 Live from a place of love and compassion 🤝 Be of greater service to our communities and the world 🌟 Deepen our connection with Spirit/Source 🌍 Become a conscious co-creator of a more harmonious future
